claims.claim: The candidate changes exactly tests/test_git_fixture_isolation.py; no production modules, helpers, existing tests, pytest configuration, or workflows were changed.

The new real-Git conformance test creates two independent sandboxes and proves isolation of writable worktree/index state, local refs and branches, writable remote refs, repository-local Git configuration, clean/dirty state, and .git/aios Runtime and lock state.
The isolation contract explicitly makes no assertion about Git object-directory identity, permitting later reuse of immutable Git objects or baseline material.
The test uses the existing real local Git repository harness and local bare remotes without mocks, skips, xfails, deselection, caching, timeout inflation, or parallel execution.
The candidate only adds the executable isolation guard and introduces no harness acceleration, production or Runtime semantic change, performance-success claim, or authority change.
